inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "The hunters' grounds, the ash and obsidian land where the Sovereign's hunters keep the trophies of every beast and every army they have caught. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. One whole region shown as one wide connected panorama, read left to right in three places: the ash flats, then the bounty board, then the hunt lodge. Bare at the left, more and more built up toward the chief's place at the right end. Every part continues into the next with the same light, the same horizon and the same floor; nothing is repeated.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Soft violet dusk light from the upper left, deep blue shadows, violet glow from the obsidian veins, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ash floor in calm even light, bright and readable.", "color_palette": ["#7a6aa8", "#b8a8d8", "#e8dcf0", "#3a3448", "#1e1a26", "#8a4ad0", "#c08af0", "#9a9a9e", "#c8c6c4", "#5a5660", "#e8e0d0", "#8a5a3a", "#d8b45a", "#a8a6b0", "#8a8896"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage panorama seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no people. The top part is sky above a distant horizon with the region's landmark. Behind the arena the scenery stands in overlapping rows at different depths, with one big set piece for each of the three places and low framing pieces in the near foreground. The lower part is one flat calm arena floor running the whole width.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 260, 1000], "desc": "a pale lavender dusk sky with long violet clouds"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [143, 0, 442, 1000], "desc": "a long line of black obsidian cliffs streaked with glowing violet veins, and at the right end a colossal obsidian wall hung with the giant skulls of beasts from every land, the region's landmark"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [364, 0, 559, 1000], "desc": "behind the arena: drifts of grey ash, black obsidian shards, iron bear traps, hanging rope nets, racks
